parameters.help_en: The AgentSpace name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The metadata field mapping. The key is the business field and the value is the storage field
fields.help_zh: 元数据字段映射，key 为业务字段，value 为存储字段
fields.name: metadata_field

fields.help_en: The experience mining interval, which specifies how often experience mining is performed. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d. Default value: 1d. This value cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: 经验挖掘间隔，控制多久执行一次经验挖掘；可选 1h/6h/12h/1d，默认 1d。创建后不可变更
fields.name: mining_interval

fields.help_en: The list of service names. This parameter is required and cannot be empty. It works with source.agentSpace to locate the trace data source. The trajectory extraction service uses the AgentSpace to look up the bound CMS workspace and project/logstore, and then filters by service name. This value cannot be changed after creation. No modification entry is available in the current version
fields.help_zh: 服务名列表，必填且非空；与 source.agentSpace 协同定位 trace 数据源（trajectory 抽取服务用 agentSpace 自查绑定的 cms workspace + project/logstore，再按 serviceName 过滤）。创建后不可变更（本期无修改入口）
fields.name: service_names

fields.help_en: The AgentSpace where the trace data source resides. If not specified, the AgentSpace in the current path is used by default. Cross-AgentSpace access is not supported in the current version. If specified, the value must match the AgentSpace in the path. Otherwise, a 400 parameter error is returned. This value cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: trace 数据源所在的 AgentSpace；不传默认为当前 path 中的 AgentSpace。本期不支持跨 AgentSpace，若传入必须等于 path AgentSpace，否则返回 400 参数错误。创建后不可变更
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The start time for data backfill, in ISO 8601 UTC format. If not specified, the current time is used
fields.help_zh: 数据回灌起始时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式；不传表示从当前时间开始
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The datasource config, which serves only as the root identifier for the data source. This is an optional block
fields.help_zh: 数据源配置，仅作为数据源根标识；可选块
fields.name: source

parameters.help_en: The context store configuration, including the datasource config and metadata field mapping
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库配置，包含数据源、元数据字段映射等
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The context store name, which must be globally unique within the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库名称，AgentSpace 内全局唯一，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The context store type. Valid values: experience and memory
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库类型，枚举值，例如 experience（经验库）、memory（记忆库）等
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the context store, which helps users understand its purpose
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库描述，便于业务方理解用途
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token, which is a unique string generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the create operation
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证创建操作幂等
parameters.name: client_token

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
